# @ndigo/host

Ndigo Host — centralized micro frontend orchestration in the shell context

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `HostRegistrationOptions` *(type)* — Options for registering a feature with a HostManager.
- `HostManagerOptions` *(type)* — Options for the HostManager.
- `HOST_MANAGER_TOKEN` — ContextToken for resolving the host orchestrator through the context hierarchy — the same placement pattern as `SHARED_DEPENDENCY_REGISTRY_TOKEN`.
- `HostManager` — Creates, tracks, and tears down feature contexts and their route partitions.
